segs: ONLINE FOLLOW-UP
AND GROWTH SITE
STARTINGWITHGOD.COM
Surfing the internet you’ll find thousands upon
thousands of Christian websites but you’ll notice
something strange: there is really no place you can
send a new or young believer to ground them in the
basics of the Christian faith and help them grow in
their relationship with Christ.
Drawing from her experience in developing one of
the most popular and fruitful Christian sites on the
internet (Everystudent.com), Marilyn Adamson
has launched a new site for on-line follow-up and
discipleship of new and young believers.
S TA RT I N G W I T H G O D.CO M 1
The evangelistic ease and opportunity of sending
someone to everystudent.com to explore the gospel is
now available for discipleship.
At StartingWithGod.com a young believer can find
helpful articles dealing with foundational truths and
principles that will ground them in their relationship
with God. They can sign up for e-mail studies of the
Scripture, engage in online chats, learn how to share
their faith, and ask any and all questions that arise as
they pursue their walk with God.
As a stand-alone strategy or simply to augment
personal discipleship StartingWithGod.com is an
essential tool for anyone seeking to make disciples.
To explore the site go to: StartingWithGod.com
